# iOS makes a calendar (MKCALENDAR with name, color, order, component set
# and a time zone, which is dropped), then changes the color by PROPPATCH.
# PROPPATCH is atomic: an unknown property is 403, the rest 424, nothing
# changes.
# The virtual default exists for the device, too.
> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
< status 405

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <B:mkcalendar xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav">
>   <A:set xmlns:A="DAV:">
>     <A:prop>
>       <A:displayname>Arbeit</A:displayname>
>       <D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/" symbolic-color="red">#FF2968FF</D:calendar-color>
>       <D:calendar-order xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">3</D:calendar-order>
>       <B:calendar-description>Termine im Büro</B:calendar-description>
>       <B:supported-calendar-component-set><B:comp name="VEVENT"/></B:supported-calendar-component-set>
>       <B:calendar-timezone>BEGIN:VCALENDAR
> BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
> TZID:Europe/Berlin
> END:VTIMEZONE
> END:VCALENDAR</B:calendar-timezone>
>       <B:schedule-calendar-transp><B:opaque/></B:schedule-calendar-transp>
>     </A:prop>
>   </A:set>
> </B:mkcalendar>
< status 201

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ d:displayname Arbeit
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ ical:calendar-color #FF2968FF
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ ical:calendar-order 3
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ cal:calendar-description Termine im Büro
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ d:resourcetype <cal:calendar/>

> MKCALENDAR /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
< status 405

> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:set><A:prop><D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">#1BADF8</D:calendar-color></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207
< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ 200 ical:calendar-color

> PROPFIND /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
> Depth: 0
< status 207
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ ical:calendar-color #1BADF8
# The change moves the ctag (<epoch>-<seq>): other devices see it.
< body-lacks -0</cs:getctag>
< body-has -1</cs:getctag>

# An unknown property: 403 for it, 424 for the color, nothing changes.
> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:X="http://example.com/ns/"><A:set><A:prop><D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">#00FF00</D:calendar-color><X:mood>fine</X:mood><A:displayname>Neu</A:displayname></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207
< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ 403 x:mood
< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ 424 ical:calendar-color d:displayname

# A value the property cannot hold: 409, the rest 424.

> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:set><A:prop><D:calendar-color xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">red</D:calendar-color><D:calendar-order xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">1</D:calendar-order></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207

< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ 424 ical:calendar-order

# Removing a property that is not there is fine; protected ones are 403.
> PROPPATCH /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:X="http://example.com/ns/"><A:remove><A:prop><X:mood/></A:prop></A:remove><A:set><A:prop><A:displayname>Büro</A:displayname><B:calendar-description xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"/></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
< status 207
< prop /caldav/alex/calendars/3F2504E0-4F89-11D3-9A0C-0305E82C3301/ 200 x:mood d:displayname cal:calendar-description
